findings.description: The scoring pipeline incorrectly includes `phq9_difficulty` (the difficulty question at the bottom of the PHQ-9 form) as a 10th item in the PHQ-9 score calculations, violating the PHQ-9 scoring guide which explicitly states that difficulty is not part of any score.
findings.evidence: 505 rows affected for phq9_total, phq9_band, and phq9_prorated where responses involving phq9_difficulty were treated as part of the 9-item scale (e.g. respondent R0094 where phq9_difficulty was missing (-9) was incorrectly marked as prorated True out of 10 items).
